'''Noel Gregory Felix'''<ref>{{cite web |title=Noel Gregory Felix - Player Profile |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/player/148389/Noel-Gregory-Felix |website=FIBA.basketball |access-date=11 October 2024}}</ref> (born October 4, 1981) is a former Belizean<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20100618000831/http://bbfbelize.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=60&Itemid=60 Belize 2009 National Team], June 17, 2010</ref><ref>[http://edition.channel5belize.com/archives/34250 Potential players for the National team hit the court], June 17, 2010</ref>-American professional [[basketball]] player born in [[Los Angeles, California]].

A 6'9", 225 lb. forward-center from [[Fresno State Bulldogs men's basketball|Fresno State]], Felix was the [[Continental Basketball Association]] (CBA) Defensive Player of the Year and earned All-CBA First Team honors in the 2005–06 season, playing for the [[Sioux Falls Skyforce]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Noel Felix minor league basketball statistics |url=https://www.statscrew.com/minorbasketball/stats/p-felixnoe001 |website=Stats Crew |access-date=June 22, 2021}}</ref>

Felix signed a 10-day contract with the Sonics as an [[undrafted]] free agent on March 2, 2006. At the end of that month, he was signed for the remainder of the season, appearing in a total of 12 games and averaging 1.5 ppg. 
In October 2006, Felix was waived by the Sonics. Later that month he signed a two-year contract with Israel's [[Maccabi Tel Aviv (basketball)|Maccabi Tel Aviv]].<ref>{{cite web| title =Maccabi signs forward Felix (Euroleague Basketball website)| date =2006-10-10| url =http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/1461/maccabi-signs-forward-felix| accessdate=2015-02-16 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20150216084642/http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/1461/maccabi-signs-forward-felix |archive-date=2015-02-16 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

Felix started the 2007–08 season playing in the NBA Development League playing for the [[Anaheim Arsenal]] but in December 2007 signed with [[Hapoel Jerusalem B.C.|Hapoel Jerusalem]].<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20150216030327/http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/eurocup/news/i/21328/hapoel-inks-ex-maccabi-big-man-felix Hapoel inks ex-Maccabi big man Felix], December 22, 2007</ref>

In 2010, Felix spent time with the [[Springfield Armor]] and [[Maine Red Claws]] of the [[NBA Development League]].<ref>[http://www.nba.com/dleague/maine/trade_021510.html RED CLAWS ACQUIRE ALMOND, CUMMINGS FROM SPRINGFIELD]</ref>

In 2011, Felix joined the [[Dacin Tigers]] of the [[Super Basketball League]].
